verdict.rationale: Sift is a fraud-detection and risk-scoring SaaS. Applications send it events and decisions over REST APIs, SDKs and a JS snippet, and it returns risk scores and runs Workflows. Acting as an MCP client or host that loads external MCP servers and calls their tools is an AI-agent role outside this product category, and nothing in the evidence shows Sift ships any agent or tool-consuming capability that would make the axis apply.
